tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background: soft blush pink by day, deep plum by night. Text on it: ink (9.4:1+), ink-soft (5.6:1+).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Frosted-glass panel fill (white at 55% by day, 10% by night) for cards, the hours panel and the year-grid card. Always over the page glow, with blur-glass and a glass-edge rim. Text on it: ink (6.9:1+), ink-soft (5:1+) even over the strongest glow.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Pressed-in tint (raspberry at 8% by day, black at 20% by night) inside a glass card: the scrollable year-grid area. Text on it: ink-soft (5.5:1+).

tokens.name: cell-empty
tokens.usage: The 2px outline of a year-grid cell with no entry, plus the unfilled slider track and upcoming stepper segments. Draw empty cells as an outline, never a solid fill, so they cannot be mistaken for a pale tracker color. Carries no text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text and the selected-choice and focus rings, on surface, card and sunken in both themes (9.4:1+). Deep plum by day, not blue.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text (legend labels, scale numbers, header letters, taglines) on surface, glass and sunken; 5.5:1+ in both themes.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button, the slider fill and the active stepper segment, and the arrow glyph in its disc: glossy raspberry rose by day, soft pink by night.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text on an action fill and the fill of the arrow disc beside it (5.0:1 by day, 7.1:1 by night).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Orchid. The brand's soft pink-lilac: hero blocks, the cover's secondary slab and highlights. Text on it: on-pastel (7.7:1). A decorative fill only.

tokens.name: on-pastel
tokens.usage: Text on every tracker fill and on accent. It does not change with the theme because tracker fills do not; 4.5:1 or better on each.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Lighter frosted fill (white at 40% by day, 12% by night) for the secondary button, nudge buttons, legend chips and the stepper bar. Over the page glow with blur-glass-sm; text on it: ink (7:1+).

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: The 1.5px bright rim around every glass element (cards, chips, tiles, nudge buttons). Decorative only.

tokens.name: glow-pink
tokens.usage: Soft blurred blob of colour behind glass: the main glow, top left of the page. Glass needs something colourful behind it to show off its blur. Decorative only.

tokens.name: glow-orchid
tokens.usage: Second glow, mid right: soft orchid. Decorative only.

tokens.name: glow-peach
tokens.usage: Third glow, bottom left: warm peach. Decorative only.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Solid 3px focus outline offset 3px, so it lands on surface or card, where it holds 8.9:1+ in both themes.

tokens.name: mood-great
tokens.usage: Mood 'Great': choice tile and year-grid cell. Lightest step of the mood spectrum (butter, like the yellow stat card in the reference). Label: on-pastel.

tokens.name: mood-good
tokens.usage: Mood 'Good': choice tile and year-grid cell (soft mint, from the reference's plant green). Label: on-pastel.

tokens.name: mood-okay
tokens.usage: Mood 'Okay': choice tile and year-grid cell (powder blue, from the reference's blue stat card). Label: on-pastel.

tokens.name: mood-not-good
tokens.usage: Mood 'Not Good': choice tile and year-grid cell. A soft lilac, not a red, so a hard day never looks like an alarm and the scale avoids red-green pairs. Darkest mood step. Label: on-pastel.

tokens.name: energy-low
tokens.usage: Energy 'Low': choice tile and grid cell. Palest step of the candy-pink energy ramp. Label: on-pastel.

tokens.name: energy-medium
tokens.usage: Energy 'Medium': choice tile and grid cell. Label: on-pastel.

tokens.name: energy-high
tokens.usage: Energy 'High': choice tile and grid cell. Strongest step of the pink ramp (rosy). Label: on-pastel.

tokens.name: anxiety-calm
tokens.usage: Anxiety 'Calm': choice tile and grid cell. Palest step of the leaf-green anxiety ramp. Label: on-pastel.

tokens.name: anxiety-mild
tokens.usage: Anxiety 'Mild': choice tile and grid cell. Label: on-pastel.

tokens.name: anxiety-high
tokens.usage: Anxiety 'High': choice tile and grid cell. Deepest leaf-green step. Label: on-pastel.

tokens.name: sleep-poor
tokens.usage: Sleep rating 'Poor': choice tile and grid cell. Palest step of the lilac night ramp. Label: on-pastel.

tokens.name: sleep-fair
tokens.usage: Sleep rating 'Fair': choice tile and grid cell. Label: on-pastel.

tokens.name: sleep-good
tokens.usage: Sleep rating 'Good': choice tile and grid cell. Deepest lilac step. Label: on-pastel.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The start-page title. One per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The question on each tracker page.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Tracker card titles in the annual overview.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: The big live readout above the sleep slider.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: J F M A M J J A S O N D
styles.usage: Month letters and day numbers on the year grid.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside legends and between grid-adjacent labels.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between stepper dots and legend chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between choice tiles.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page side gutter and card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between the parts of a question.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between tracker cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Bottom page padding, large section gaps.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space around the hero on the start page.

tokens.name: grid-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between year-grid cells.

tokens.name: grid-cell
tokens.usage: Width and height of one year-grid cell.

tokens.name: grid-label
tokens.usage: Width of the day-number column of a year grid.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of any button; choice tiles are at least 80px, choice rows 64px.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur behind glass cards and panels (with saturate 1.5).

tokens.name: blur-glass-sm
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur behind small glass: chips, nudge buttons, the secondary button, sticky grid headers.

tokens.name: radius-cell
tokens.usage: Year-grid cells.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: The pressed-in scrollable grid area.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Choice tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Clay cards and the hours panel.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero shapes and large slabs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, glass chips, stepper dots, slider track and thumb.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Glass cards: a long soft drop shadow, a bright 1.5px top-edge highlight, a faint inner rim and a light inner glow at the bottom, so the panel looks like a thick pane of glass.

tokens.name: shadow-tile
tokens.usage: Glass tiles, the slider thumb and the glass buttons: the card shadow at tile size.

tokens.name: shadow-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed-in areas: the year-grid scroll area and the slider track.

tokens.name: shadow-button
tokens.usage: The primary button: a glossy highlight on top and a deeper shade underneath.

tokens.name: shadow-cell
tokens.usage: A filled year-grid cell: a tiny highlight so each day looks like a soft pebble.
